in_sanskrit.name: Jalindar
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है God of rivers
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Jalindar एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Jalindar is derived from two Sanskrit words: 'Jal' meaning water and 'Indra' meaning lord. It represents the god of rivers, particularly the god Indra who is believed to control the rains and water resources.
